chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

It is upon the Imam to perform the Zuhr prayer on the Day of Tarwiyah at Masjid al-Khayf, and to perform the Zuhr prayer on the Day of Nafr in al-Masjid al-Haram. The correct way to understand these reports is that they apply specifically to the Imam, to the exclusion of others; that is what they indicate, and there is no contradiction between them and what we have previously presented.

key_terms.يَوْمَ ٱلتَّرْوِيَةِ: the Day of Tarwiyah, the eighth day of Dhu al-Hijjah in the hajj rites
key_terms.يَوْمَ ٱلنَّفْرِ: the Day of Nafr, the day of departure from Mina
key_terms.ٱلْأَخْبَارِ: the reports or hadiths under discussion
key_terms.ٱلْإِمَامِ: the Imam, specifically singled out for this ruling

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about where the Imam should pray on the Day of Tarwiyah and the Day of Nafr during hajj?
ai.summary: This report discusses a legal ruling concerning the Imam’s specific prayer locations during the rites of hajj. It clarifies that the instruction is exclusive to the Imam and therefore does not conflict with other reports concerning the general pilgrims.
